name: eskiu-language
description: Eskiu language support: highlighting, live errors, completion, hover with types and signatures, signature help, go to definition, outline, formatting and Run

eskiu.compilerPath.markdownDescription: Path to `eskiuc`. Empty uses `build/eskiuc` or `build22/eskiuc` in workspace folders, else `eskiuc` on `PATH`. Set it when the editor does not inherit your shell `PATH`.

eskiu.entryPoint.markdownDescription: Optional entry point file for multi-file projects (e.g. `kernel.esk` or `main.esk`). If empty, Eskiu auto-detects root files that import the active file.

eskiu.compilerFlags.markdownDescription: Extra command-line flags to pass to `eskiuc` (e.g. `["--freestanding"]`, `["-Wall", "-Wno-format"]`). Default-on warnings (`-Wformat`, `-Wstring-compare`, ...) show as warnings; each `-Wno-` flag turns one off.

eskiu.checkOnType.description: Type-check while typing, not only when a file is opened or saved.

eskiu.checkDelay.description: Milliseconds to wait after the last edit before type-checking.
